{{Quote|You're running out of executioners, Baron.|Rahm Kota, after killing Frank|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Frank''' was a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] at the [[Tarko-se Arena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="TFUII" /> He was the cousin of [[Nym/Legends|Nym]],<ref name="TFUIICEDAB">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II Collector's Edition digital art book|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' Collector's Edition digital art book]]</ref> a Feeorin [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Frank was one of the executioners used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]],<ref name="TFUII" /> who had been captured in a failed [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|raid]] on the planet for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="TFUIINovel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> Frank used a [[Club/Legends|club]]-like [[Staff/Legends|staff]] to fight Kota, but when the Feeorin engaged Kota in combat, he was defeated and killed after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] slashed him in the back with his [[Rahm Kota's lightsaber|lightsaber]].<ref name="TFUII" />

Frank had [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin. By that same time, at least two of his head tendrils had been severed, and he had acquired an X-shaped scar on his forehead. During his battle with Kota, Frank wore dark-colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a large club-like staff.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We needed a character to go down like a punk for General Kota's intro in the Cato Neimoidia arena. It was also a great chance to go through our concept art archive and resurrect a character that never made it into a game. Anyone remember Nym, the Feeorin pirate from ''Star Wars'': Starfighter and ''Star Wars'': Jedi Starfighter, who led raids against the trade federation? Meet his cousin, Frank.|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' digital art book|<ref name="TFUIICEDAB" />}}
Frank first appeared in the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. In concept art in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II Collector's Edition digital art book|digital art book]] that came with the Collector's Edition version of the game, the gladiator is identified as "Frank," the cousin of Nym&mdash;a Feeorin character designed for two earlier games, [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''. Frank was designed for ''The Force Unleashed II'' after he was found in concept art archives of characters that never made it into a game.<ref name="TFUIICEDAB" />
